phoṭṭhabbārammaṇa.p:
[Phoṭṭhabba+ārammaṇa] (na) CL=8 (1) The sense of touch; (Ti)
(2) Attentive to touch. See also - Gandhārammaṇa.
a: ဖောဋ္ဌဗ္ဗာရမ္မဏ(န)
[ဖောဋ္ဌဗ္ဗ+အာရမ္မဏ]
